people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: They also struck the tents of livestock, and carried away sheep in abundance, and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: They also attacked the tents of the herdsmen and carried off many sheep and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep in abundance, and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.
